candidate_outputs: separate BF16 Q in [32,32,head_dim] consumer layout

cache_ownership.local: Triton forward_metadata.swa_out_cache_loc with SWAKVPool layer mapping and get_key_buffer/get_value_buffer(attn.layer_id)
cache_ownership.dynamic_reuse: locations are read from the current ForwardBatch/backend metadata for every admitted invocation
cache_ownership.cuda_graph_rows: candidate admits exactly the captured decode-c32 shape; other batch shapes and modes fall back

source_to_consumer_proof.consumer_semantics: The candidate passes direct Q and the same pool buffers to the unchanged Triton consumer and sets save_kv_cache false only because K/V are already in their final owned rows.
source_to_consumer_proof.fallbacks: Prefill/extend, non-c32, non-BF16 producer, non-E5M2 cache, non-Triton backend, non-unit scale, unexpected stride/layout, missing SWA translation, and shared-KV all execute the untouched stock block.
source_to_consumer_proof.measured_component_relation: The runtime kernel is the accepted attempt4 direct-Q/direct-E5M2-KV kernel and preserves its local Q32/KV16/d256 and global Q32/KV4/d512 producer-to-consumer decomposition; endpoint behavior is not inferred.

bounded_behavior.claim: Refuses to claim unless the later binding authorizes this exact project, bench, readiness hash, watchdog, spend exposure, and one submission.
bounded_behavior.input_staging: Consumes only a hash-bound project-local execution packet; that packet must materialize all admitted cross-project bytes before the claim.
bounded_behavior.heartbeat: Every 30 seconds from claim through terminal/retrieval/repair.
bounded_behavior.repair: One ordinary pre-science launcher/adapter repair may be requested and rerun under the retained claim; the endpoint submission remains zero until the worker's immediate pre-request marker.
bounded_behavior.terminal: Requires compact invocation state and worker terminal, exactly one completed endpoint submission, result pass, and path proof before publishing TERMINAL.json.
bounded_behavior.release: Releases ready only after the scientific terminal; otherwise releases maintenance with typed boundary and any recovered science marker/evidence, always before the binding deadline.
